Hey Alex — thanks for sharing the logs. Quick notes after a first pass:

- The logs look good for a baseline intake; anonymization seems complete.
- A few clarifying items that help us size the trial instance and pick batching/quantization profiles:
  1) Are the requests mostly single-turn summarizations or multi-turn (i.e., do you keep a long chat history)?
  2) Do you expect many long documents >2k tokens or primarily short clinical notes (~100-400 tokens)?
  3) Any expected attachments in requests (PDFs/images) that we need to pre-process?

For capacity planning we typically assume three traffic bands: steady, sustained high, short burst. If you can reply with the steady RPS, sustained high RPS, and peak burst RPS (and durations) that's ideal.

Also proposing owners: Marissa = POC technical lead, Dylan = infra lead, Ben = commercial lead, Alex/Acme = customer POC lead. I'll prepare the trial config once we get numbers.

We use this internal checklist for quick sizing: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/poc-sizing (internal link).

Thanks — I'll be offline after 8pm PT but will pick this up tomorrow morning.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — answers below (apologies for the long email):

1) Request type: Mostly single-turn summarizations of clinical notes. We rarely keep multi-turn history in the API request.
2) Token lengths: typical prompt (context + note) = 60-220 tokens (average ~120). Typical completion size = 80-180 tokens (average ~120). So plan for ~240 tokens/request average.
3) Attachments: ~5% of requests include PDFs; those are pre-processed to text on our side and sent as text. No images currently.

Traffic profile:
- Steady-state RPS: 8 req/s
- Sustained high: 25 req/s for 30-60 minutes during morning rush
- Burst peaks: up to 150 req/s for 5-10 minutes (rare, ~1-2x/day)
- Typical concurrency: 10 active sessions; peak concurrency observed ~120
- Avg payload size: ~6KB (text-only)
- Region: us-west (West Coast users)
- Auth: API key; we can do IP allowlist for trial if needed

Attached a small set of representative payloads (sample_payloads.json) and I've included a short CSV with anonymized request traces earlier.

If those numbers work, let's lock kickoff for Monday 2027-07-19. We can aim for a 10 business day trial.

Regards,
Alex
